description: Context rules for ecommerce, marketplace, ordering, and social commerce apps.

effect.appProfileImpact: For ecommerce/marketplace apps, exported auth/payment/link activities are expected integration surfaces, but they need narrow filters, state validation, and redirect/input review before production.
Deep links are common in ecommerce, but product, payment, referral, and auth parameters need validation before release.
Ecommerce apps often include analytics/marketing SDKs; confirm consent, disclosures, and data-safety statements.
